sentences.text: ?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:109162
Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22373 of 2023

Applicant :- Kallu Khan And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhil Kumar Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Learned Aga informs that the notice on opposite party no. 2 is sufficient.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant s in Case Crime No. 51 of 2023,
under Sections 363, 366, 376-D, 120-B I.P.C., Section 3/4 POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act, Police Station Gursahaiganj, District Kannauj with the prayer to enlarge the applicants on bail.
It is submitted by learned counsel for applicants that applicants are innocent and have not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report.
It is submitted that the main role of enticing away the victim and committing rape is against co-accused Bhola Thakur.
The victim in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.. has categorically stated that the present applicants did not provide any assistance to main accused Bhola Thakur in enticing her away.

She further stated that mother of the victim lodged the first information report against the present applicant Kallu and Kallu Khan And Another vs State Of U.P.And 3 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161925173/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The victim refused to undergo for her external and internal medical examination.
As per ossification report, her age has been determined to be about 18 years.

The victim in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has made allegation of committing rape against the present applicants Kallu Khan and Gattu Khan but in fact allegation of committing rape is against co-accused Bhola Thakur.
The allegation of forceful sexual assault is not corroborated by the medical evidence.
It is also submitted that earlier the mother of the victim has lodged two cases against the applicant Kallu wherein after investigation final reports have been submitted.

Learned counsel for applicants lastly submits that applicants are in jail since 28.01.2023 having no criminal history and that in case applicants are enlarged on bail, applicants will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Per contra learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspect of the matter.

Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, at this stage, prima facie, a case for bail has been made out.
The role of present applicants are distinguishable with the role of main accused Bhola Thakur.
The prayer for bail is granted.
The application is allowed.

Let applicants, Kallu Khan and Gattu Khan, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing personal bond and two local sureties to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicants will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2). The applicants will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicants will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 18.5.2023 Prajapati  Kallu Khan And Another vs State Of U.P.And 3 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161925173/
